description: This Java class defines an event called AttributeReportEvent that models a Zigbee attribute report within a mock Zigbee core environment. It includes properties for EUI64, endpoint ID, cluster ID, attribute ID, attribute type, payload data, manufacturer-specific info, and methods to encode the payload and access these properties.

classes.name: AttributeReportEvent
classes.description: Represents a Zigbee attribute report event with methods to access report details and encode payload data.

methods.name: AttributeReportEvent (constructor)
methods.description: Initializes the event with EUI64, endpoint, cluster, attribute IDs, attribute type, payload, and optionally manufacturer code.

methods.name: getEui64
methods.description: Returns the EUI64 identifier of the device.

methods.name: getEncodedBuf
methods.description: Encodes the attribute report data as a Base64 string for transmission or storage.

methods.name: getLqi
methods.description: Returns a fixed Link Quality Indicator (LQI) value.

methods.name: isMfgSpecific
methods.description: Indicates whether the report is manufacturer-specific.
